meta.title: Assistant access — Universal Character Forge
meta.description: Connect an outside assistant to your campaigns and characters with your own account.
meta.ogDescription: Connect an outside assistant to your campaigns and characters with your own account.

page.title: Assistant access
page.description: Let an assistant you already use read and update your campaigns and character sheets.

endpoint.label: Connection address
endpoint.help: Paste this address into the assistant you want to connect. It will ask you to sign in with your usual account and approve access.

access.title: What an assistant can do
access.description: An assistant only ever sees what you can see, and can only change what you are allowed to change.
access.pointOne: Browse your campaigns, world entries and character sheets.
access.pointTwo: Game Master notes stay hidden from anyone who is not the Game Master.
access.pointThree: You can refuse a connection at any time on the approval screen.

meta.title: Approve access — Universal Character Forge
meta.description: Review and approve an assistant's request to use your account.

consent.title: Approve access
consent.description: {{app}} wants to use your account to read and update your campaigns and characters.
consent.redirecting: Taking you back to the app…
consent.invalidDescription: The request is missing or has expired. Start the connection again from the app you were using.
consent.errorTitle: We could not load this request
consent.errorDescription: The request may have expired. Try again, or start the connection again from the app you were using.
